description: Recognition requirements (Campus Activities recognition pages, Student Handbook 2026-27) and every clause of the 2026-27 RSO Constitution Template.

rules.title: Five required officers
rules.source_text: Five required officers: president, vice president, secretary, treasurer, and programming chair.
rules.message: The application must list five officers: president, vice president, secretary, treasurer and programming chair.

rules.title: A full-time faculty or staff advisor
rules.source_text: One full-time USC faculty or staff advisor not currently on sabbatical or leave.
rules.message: The application needs one full-time USC faculty or staff advisor who is not on sabbatical or leave.
rules.fix_template: Ask a full-time faculty or staff member to serve as advisor.

rules.title: At least five more student members
rules.source_text: At least five additional student members.
rules.message: Besides the five officers, list at least five more student members.

rules.title: At least 10 enrolled students including 5 officers
rules.source_text: Consist of at least 10 currently enrolled USC students, including 5 student officers.
rules.message: A recognized club must have at least 10 currently enrolled USC students, including the 5 officers.

rules.title: Everyone accepts their position on EngageSC
rules.source_text: All must accept/approve their positions through EngageSC. Follow the instructions in the email sent from mailer@campusgroups.com to accept/approve a position. You must accept from a laptop or desktop computer (not mobile).
rules.message: Every officer, member and the advisor must accept their position in EngageSC from a laptop or desktop computer.
rules.fix_template: Remind {names} to accept their position in EngageSC.

rules.title: Constitution on the 2026-27 fillable template
rules.source_text: Submit a Constitution using the required 2026-27 template. You must use the required fillable form template below and maintain the fillable form format. Do not print to PDF or flatten your final document.
rules.message: Submit the constitution on the 2026-27 fillable template. Do not print it to PDF or flatten it.
rules.fix_template: Re-enter the constitution in the 2026-27 fillable template and save it as a fillable form.

rules.title: Accountability Document on the 2026-27 template
rules.source_text: Submit an Accountability Document using the required 2026-27 template. You must use the required fillable form template below and maintain the fillable form format. Do not print to PDF or flatten your final document.
rules.message: Submit an Accountability Document on the 2026-27 fillable template.

rules.title: Each officer signs the Commitment to Community
rules.source_section: Individual Officer Requirements: Commitment to Community Form
rules.source_text: The five officers listed on the application must individually complete the Commitment to Community Form and send the completed document to the officer submitting the application.
rules.message: Each of the five officers signs the 2026-27 Commitment to Community form (by DocuSign) and sends it to the officer submitting the application.
rules.fix_template: {officer} still needs to sign the Commitment to Community form.

rules.title: Each officer completes this year's trainings
rules.source_text: The five officers listed on the recognition application must complete the required annual training between July 1, 2026 and the application deadline. Only currently enrolled students will be able to access the trainings via SSO.
rules.message: Each of the five officers completes Hazing Prevention 101 and the RSO Officer Learning Path between July 1, 2026 and the application deadline. Older certificates are not accepted.
rules.notes: Sources disagree: the constitution template (Article III, Section B, Part 1) names Hazing Prevention, Event Accessibility and RSO Officer Training modules. Greenlight lists every training either source names and asks the officer to confirm with Campus Activities.

rules.title: Three documents per officer
rules.source_text: Each officer should send their three requirements (Hazing Prevention 101 certificate, Officer Learning Path certificate, and Commitment to Community form) to the officer submitting the application, who will upload all documents to the application.
rules.message: For each of the five officers, upload three documents: the Hazing Prevention 101 certificate, the Officer Learning Path certificate and the Commitment to Community form (15 in all).

rules.title: Spring 2027 recognition: application closes November 22 at 11:59 pm
rules.source_text: October 27: Application opens November 22 at 11:59pm: Application closes. You must submit the form on EngageSC before 11:59pm . Late applications are not accepted.
rules.message: The Spring 2027 recognition application opened October 27 and closes November 22, 2026 at 11:59 pm. Late applications are not accepted.
rules.fix_template: Submit on EngageSC before 11:59 pm on November 22, 2026.
rules.applies_to: New clubs and clubs re-establishing after a lapse, Spring 2027 cycle

rules.title: Advisor requirements due December 1
rules.source_text: December 1: Deadline for advisors to submit their requirements.
rules.message: The advisor's own requirements (training certificate and Commitment to Community, by Google Form) are due December 1, 2026.
rules.fix_template: Remind the advisor to submit their requirements by December 1, 2026.

rules.title: Advisor requirements are annual
rules.source_text: RSO advisors must complete annual requirements as part of each RSO’s recognition application and documents from previous years are not accepted.
rules.message: The advisor must complete this year's advisor requirements; documents from previous years are not accepted.
rules.fix_template: Ask the advisor to complete this year's requirements.

rules.title: One required officer submits the application
rules.source_section: Before You Begin: Who submits the application?
rules.source_text: The application must be submitted by an officer listed as one of the five required positions on the application (president, vice president, secretary, treasurer, and programming chair). The application is not transferrable to any other officer and cannot be edited by any other officer.
rules.message: One of the five required officers submits the application, and only that officer can see or edit it afterwards.

rules.title: Incomplete applications are not considered
rules.source: Campus Activities: FAQ, RSO Recognition Process
rules.source_section: FAQ: What happens if we do not complete the entire recognition process before the deadlines?
rules.source_text: Incomplete applications will not be considered for recognition. RSOs who do not complete their applications will have to wait until the next recognition process.
rules.message: An incomplete application is not considered; the club waits for the next recognition cycle.
rules.fix_template: Complete every item before the deadline.

rules.title: Appeal a denial within 10 business days
rules.source_text: Denials of recognition applications submitted to Campus Activities may be appealed to the AVP for Leadership and Community, or designee, within ten business days of the receipt of the decision. Appeals are limited to a written statement of no more than 5 pages, submitted via email to Campus Activities.
rules.message: A denial can be appealed within 10 business days of receiving the decision, with a written statement of at most 5 pages emailed to Campus Activities.
rules.notes: The Handbook names the AVP for Leadership and Community; the Campus Activities FAQ names the AVP for Student Culture and Community. Both say ten business days.

rules.title: No academic limits on membership
rules.source_text: Groups may not limit membership based on major/program of study, year/class standing (including undergraduate or graduate student standing), GPA, or other academic requirements.
rules.message: Membership cannot be limited by major, class standing, GPA or other academic requirements.
rules.fix_template: Replace the academic criterion with attendance, participation or length of membership.

rules.title: No interviews, applications or assessments for membership
rules.source_text: Groups may not extend barriers to membership such as interviews, applications, or assessments.
rules.message: Membership cannot depend on an interview, application or assessment.
rules.fix_template: Replace the interview or application with attendance, participation or length of membership.

rules.title: No required membership in another organization
rules.source_text: Groups may not require membership in any other organization (for example, a parent organization or national honor society).
rules.message: Membership cannot require belonging to another organization.
rules.fix_template: Remove the requirement to belong to another organization.

rules.title: Membership criteria should be about attendance and participation
rules.source_text: Criteria for Voting and General Membership should focus on attendance, participation, and length of membership.
rules.message: Criteria for voting and general membership should be about attendance, participation and length of membership.
